name: Montecorto (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of light blue, green and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Montecorto (a dolmen, a bird and a hand on blue and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Montecorto; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Montecorto arms — dolmen, bird and hand on blue and yellow
yellow field and crown of the arms
